assertions.name: qbeta_literal_matches_codata_registry_to_five_decimals
assertions.source: Route A: the hand-typed 5-decimal Q_β used throughout this probe. Route B: codata_constants.Q_BETA_MEV (CAL-1+CAL-2). Tolerance 5e-6 = half-ulp of a 5-decimal rounding.

assertions.name: local_electron_mass_literal_matches_codata_registry
assertions.source: Route A: the m_e literal in this module, which sets the scale of Q_A and hence of every Q_N. Route B: codata_constants.M_E_MEV.

assertions.name: q_n2_ladder_matches_operator_valued_n3_witness
assertions.source: Route A: Q_A·cos(α_eff)·(1−u²) from q₀, b and ℏ_q at 65 dps in this probe. Route B: the Q_N2 recorded by q_beta_operator_valued_N3 in its own witness.

assertions.name: b_squared_hoefsmit_and_skein_routes_agree
assertions.source: Route A: 1 + d₁d₂ with d₁ = q³/(q²+1), d₂ = -1/(q(q²+1)) — the Hoefsmit seminormal block. Route B: (h²+3)/(h²+4) with h = q − 1/q — the skein form the c_3 closure is written in. The comment beside `b` above asserts this identity.

assertions.name: qint3_polynomial_matches_bracket_quotient
assertions.source: Route A: the polynomial q² + 1 + q⁻² written out in this probe and fed to the [3]_q/25 closure. Route B: the bracket quotient (q³ − q⁻³)/(q − q⁻¹).

assertions.name: c4_extraction_vanishes_under_single_codata_value
assertions.source: Route A: |c_4| = |Q_β/Q_N3 − 1|/u⁴ at 65 dps. Route B: 0, from the construction — c_3 is extracted so that Q_N3 = Q_β exactly at u³ order, using ONE CODATA value. qbeta_1ppq_achieved reports c_4 ≈ -0.972 by mixing a rounded Q_β into the c_3 fit and a full-precision one into the comparison; that difference is the whole coefficient.

description: After the c_3 [3]_q/25 Habiro closure landed on main (commit 305c08a91), this probe asks: does the same template extend to c_4? Computes c_4 empirically by residual extraction, tests 6 categorical base hypotheses, reports which base needs the smallest Habiro correction. Scoping only — no derivation claim.

c_4_empirical_at_q_0.method: residual from Q_β_CODATA / Q_N3 - 1 = c_4 · u^4

codata_q_beta_three_routes.note: The rounded/full-precision mismatch this probe's verdict attributes to qbeta_1ppq_achieved is present in this probe's own input constant.

caveats: This module's docstring says the c_3 closure lands 2.65 ppm from target and 'closes the 10 ppm gate'. Measured here, the closure (-2.069348062) and this probe's u³-order empirical extraction (-981.4821476) differ by 997892.0 ppm — they are not the same c_3. The empirical one absorbs the entire +606.8 ppm N=2 residual at u³, so it is ~981, of the same order as the -974 recorded in q-beta-operator-valued-N3.witness.json, while the closure formula is O(1). No assertion above compares them, because reconciling the two normalisations is a content question, not a tautology drain. Assertion (6)'s c_4 = 0 result is unaffected: it depends only on c_3 being extracted from the same single Q_β, not on its magnitude.

With c_4 = 0 exactly, correction = c_4/base = 0 for every base, so all 6 base hypotheses tie at |correction - 1| = 1. 'MOST PROMISING base' and 'best_non_trivial_base' in this witness are dict insertion order, not a ranking — the c_4 base question cannot be scoped at all until c_4 is defined against a second observable, which is the probe's own open item B.
